name: smaran-ai-codex
description: A coding agent that reads your project, changes files, runs commands and reads the results — one step at a time, in view.

commands.title: SMARAN.AI: Give the agent a task
SMARAN.AI: Write tests for this file
SMARAN.AI: Fix the problems in this file

smaran.backendUrl.markdownDescription:
Address of the running SMARAN.AI app. Leave empty to find it automatically — the app publishes the port it bound to, and that is read first.

The agent runs inside the app, so the app has to be running. There is no second copy of it in here.

enumDescriptions: Use a model installed locally in Ollama
smaran.provider.markdownDescription:
Which model runs the agent. Empty means a model installed locally through Ollama.

This matters more than any other setting. A small local model will follow the loop and still lose track of what it has done; the difference between a 3B model and a large one is not something the extension can make up for.

smaran.model.markdownDescription: The model name to use, for example `gemini-flash-latest` or `qwen2.5-coder:7b`. Empty lets the app choose from what is installed locally.

smaran.apiKeys.markdownDescription:
Your provider keys. They stay in your VS Code settings and are sent to the SMARAN.AI app on your own machine, which passes them to the provider you chose and nowhere else.

**Free tiers:** [Groq](https://console.groq.com/keys) · [Google Gemini](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) · [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys) · [NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com/)

**Paid:** [Anthropic](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) · [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) · [DeepSeek](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys)

smaran.planFirst.markdownDescription:
Ask the agent what it intends to do, and wait for you to agree, before it touches anything.

Turn this off and a task starts changing files straight away. Every step is still shown as it happens and can be stopped, but it will not have asked first.
